drafts.walkScript: Line 48 says a door was mistaken "In the agitation and half darkness" the night before. Line 4 says "We're in the new house"; lines 53 and 54 show a missed supper. A mistaken door and a missed supper show an upset, muddled arrival after dark. So "agitation" means "the upset and muddle of arriving late at night". The darkness is the time, not the feeling; nothing is stirred, and the room comes later.

Line 44 says "Somebody has to keep the goal." Line 43 says "I'm not shifting out of there", so "there" means the goal. The speaker is staying put in goal and will not leave it. So "shifting" means "Moving away from a place." Stacking jumpers is line 42, and nobody changes shape or works a turn at a job.
